drifted.spec_text: IBlockDevice provides 10 methods: connect_client, sector_size, num_sectors, max_queue_depth, num_io_queues, max_transfer_size, block_size, numa_node, nvme_version, telemetry.
drifted.actual: Interface has an 11th method, read_write_stats(&self) -> ReadWriteStats, returning cumulative SSD read/write byte, op, and latency counters. New ReadWriteStats type is also unlisted.

drifted.spec_text: IDispatchMap provides 16 methods (initialize, lookup, convert_to_storage, take_read, take_write, release_read, release_write, downgrade_reference, remove, touch, entry_size, oldest_keys, create_memory_tier_entry, convert_memory_tier_to_block, is_evictable, recover_extent).
drifted.actual: Two additional methods exist: promote_block_to_memory_tier(key, pointer, size) - in-place BlockDevice->MemoryTier promotion preserving ref counts - and try_evict_to_block(key) - atomic evictability check + demotion to BlockDevice.

drifted.spec_text: IDispatcher provides 16 methods (initialize, shutdown, lookup, lookup_async, batch_lookup, check, remove, populate, reserve_memory, copy_gpu_to_memory_async, copy_gpu_to_memory_completed, release_memory, touch, promote_to_memory_tier, clear_memory_tier, flush_to_ssd).
drifted.actual: Three additional methods exist: pin(key)/unpin(key) for eviction-protection reference counting, and read_write_stats(&self) -> ReadWriteStats for cumulative SSD telemetry.

drifted.spec_text: IMemoryTier provides 16 methods (initialize, insert, get, peek, evict_lru, evict_lru_for_key, oldest_keys, remove, touch, batch_touch, contains, capacity, used, pool_info, is_dma_capable, clear).
drifted.actual: An additional method telemetry_snapshot(&self) -> MemoryTierTelemetrySnapshot exists and is exported from lib.rs; the MemoryTierTelemetrySnapshot type has no FR entry.

drifted.spec_text: IRemoteLookup provides batch_lookup(&self, entries: &[(CacheKey, IpcHandle)]) -> Vec<Result<(), RemoteLookupError>>, join_cluster, and leave_cluster.
drifted.actual: batch_lookup signature is now &[(CacheKey, u32)] (a size hint, not a GPU IpcHandle), reflecting remote-lookup's CPU/DRAM-only 002 rewrite. A new initialize(&self, config: LookupConfig) -> Result<(), RemoteLookupError> method and the LookupConfig type (10 fields: group, quorum_pct, phase1_timeout, op_deadline, max_retry_rounds, max_keys_per_query, bind_ip, actor_cpu, discovery, node_endpoint) are entirely unlisted.

drifted.spec_text: Command: 11-variant enum for all NVMe operations. Completion: 10-variant enum for operation results.
drifted.actual: Command has 12 variants (ReadSync, WriteSync, ReadAsync, WriteAsync, WriteZeros, BatchSubmit, AbortOp, NsProbe, NsCreate, NsFormat, NsDelete, ControllerReset); Completion has 11 (ReadDone, WriteDone, WriteZerosDone, AbortAck, Timeout, NsProbeResult, NsCreated, NsFormatted, NsDeleted, ResetDone, Error). Both counts have been off since the enums' original commit; ReadWriteStats (see FR-004) is also missing from this FR.

drifted.spec_text: DispatcherConfig: 16-field configuration (PCI addrs, cache size, eviction params, poller CPU, backfill delay, partition sizes, cold-load staging slots and buffer size).
drifted.actual: DispatcherConfig has 18 fields. Four fields are entirely undocumented: memory_tier_eviction_threshold, memory_tier_eviction_low_watermark, memory_tier_eviction_batch_size, memory_tier_eviction_interval_secs (a DRAM-to-SSD proactive demotion sweep, analogous to the existing SSD eviction sweep), plus extended_metadata_partition_size.

drifted.spec_text: RemoteLookupError: 2-variant error enum. LookupRef: Zero-copy reference (pointer, size, key). RemoteRequestHandlerError: 4-variant error enum.
drifted.actual: RemoteLookupError (2 variants: NotFound, TransportError) still matches. LookupRef and RemoteRequestHandlerError no longer exist anywhere in the crate - removed together with IRemoteRequestHandler (FR-013) by commit 29902a2.

not_implemented.detail: IRemoteRequestHandler (handle_lookup, handle_check, handle_batch_lookup, release_lookup) does not exist in the crate. Removed by commit 29902a2 ('refactor: split remote-request-handler into remote-lookup-rdma-{initiator,responder}') and replaced by the unspecced IRemoteLookupRdmaInitiator/IRemoteLookupRdmaResponder pair.

IExtendedMetadataStore is implemented in components/interfaces/src/iextended_metadata_store.rs (put/get/delete/iterate_all/force_flush, added in commit 9f1f6d5) but src/lib.rs has no `mod iextended_metadata_store;` declaration or re-exports, so the trait is not part of the compiled interfaces crate. The consuming crate components/extended-metadata-store (which does `use interfaces::{ExtendedMetadataStoreError, IExtendedMetadataStore, ILogger};`) is also absent from the root Cargo.toml workspace `members` list - neither crate builds today.

ExtendedMetadataStoreError (4 variants: NotFound, StorageError, CapacityExhausted, ValueTooLarge) is correctly defined in src/iextended_metadata_store.rs:6-16 but is unreachable for the same reason as FR-014 - the module is not wired into lib.rs.
